Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the release dates of the two films. Based on the data gathered in Step 2, Lo Zappatore was released in 1950 and Placer Sangriento was released in 1967. The Planner erroneously concluded that Lo Zappatore (1950) was released more recently than Placer Sangriento (1967), which is a logical contradiction. The correct conclusion should have been that Placer Sangriento was released more recently.
